name: Monthly Financial Project Workflow
description: Workflow for processing monthly financial data

nodes.name: Retrieve Expense Report
nodes.description: Fetches expense data from Google Drive or uses sample data in demo mode

nodes.name: Analyze Expense Data
nodes.description: Processes the expense data to find patterns and generate recommendations

nodes.name: Create Visualizations
nodes.description: Creates charts and visualizations of the expense data

nodes.name: Print Summary
nodes.description: Displays a summary of the analysis results

nodes.name: Send Email Report
nodes.description: Sends the analysis results and visualizations via email

expenseReportPath.description: Path to the retrieved expense report CSV file

analysisResults.description: Results of the expense analysis including summary and recommendations

emailResult.description: Status of the email sending operation

googleDriveMCP.description: Google Drive MCP instance for file operations

gmailMCP.description: Gmail MCP instance for sending emails

isDemoMode.description: Flag indicating if the workflow is running in demo mode
